title: Page 8
content_zh:
不说还好，这个话题一旦提起来，原宜之越发愤怒。

谢母就是个不识好歹的老太婆，老混蛋！

说她为老不尊都是给她面子，她根本就是自己找死，替自己儿子仕途送终。

原宜之长这么大，见过糊涂长辈，却还没见过这么愚蠢的，真难以相信谢雍这个连中三元的状元是她一手养大的！

恐怕谢雍其实是天腻异禀，歹竹出好笋了吧？

那样混帐的爹，这样愚蠢的娘，居然能养出谢雍这样的天才！

孙嬷嬷按住激动的原宜之，想想她说的话也有道理，但是女人家岂能轻言离家出走？而且自家小姐以前又有着克夫之名，好不容易出嫁了，如果再出问题，以后恐怕真的一辈子都嫁不出去了。

“你先别急，这事是老夫人擅自做主，但你应该在乎的是姑爷的态度，先看看姑爷怎么处理再说？”原宜之想了想，又缓缓地躺下，最后道：“好吧，先等等着。”

当天，原宜之一直寒着那张因孕吐而蜡黄的小脸，她觉得自己刚嫁人没三个月就成了‘黄脸婆’，实在可笑又可悲。

她不理谢雍，一直到晚上上床休息。

谢雍明白她的怒气，他又何尝不是？

当时他捏着那封信，真是用尽了平生所有的理智才没让自己发疯。

他以为远离了母亲，让她能够冷静理智一些，万没想到她反而变本加厉。

原宜之面朝着床里侧，闭着眼睛假寐。

谢雍从后面轻轻拥住她，她挣扎了一下，他却抱得更紧，她便不动了。

谢雍道：“不要生气了好不好？我看过医书，生气对孕妇和宝宝都不好。为了别人的愚蠢而气坏自己，那是傻子才做的事。”

原宜之闷声道：“我就是个傻子！总觉得好心会有好报，却不知道这世上真有暖不热的没良心！”

谢雍久久无语。

再怎么说，那也是他的亲生母亲，曾经为了他受苦受累。

第10章(2)

原宜之久久听不到动静，有点狐疑地转过身来，却惊讶地发现谢雍正默默地流眼泪。

漂亮的凤目微微发红，滚滚的泪珠悄无声息地落下来，让她又慌乱又心疼。

她嘟了嘟嘴，犹豫了一下，才轻轻地伸手为他拭泪，道：“你哭什么？我还没哭呢。真是的，大男人家怎么这么会哭，这么多眼泪？你要让你儿子笑话你没出息吗？好啦好啦，我知道不是你的错，我知道你也很难做，我是生气一下下而已，并没有怪你什么啊，不要哭啦，不丢脸吗？”

谢雍直视着她，道：“宜之，我知道这次的事伤了你的心，但是就像我从前允诺你的，我会处理好的，相信我？”

原宜之点了点头，“我相信你。”

谢雍的脸上终于露出一点笑容，道：“玲珑和青黛是过去的问题，她们无法生育已经形同废人，也算可怜，打发出去也没有好出路，就让她们伺候母亲吧，谢府为她们养老。至于以后，不会再有别人。”

原宜之扁了扁嘴，想着当年父亲是不是也对嫡母许过这样的承诺，她的生母周姨娘和另一位孙姨娘同样属于‘过去问题’，是郑氏嫁进原府之前就有的通房大丫鬟，可是后来呢，还不是又有了小郑姨娘，有了三哥的亲生姨娘，有了现在更年轻的孟姨娘？

见她满脸的不以为然，谢雍也是无奈，只得把她用力拥进怀里，低叹道：“你这个坏脾气的丫头，嘴里说着相信，心里却不以为然吧？”

原宜之又嘟了嘟嘴，小声道：“话说的漂亮没用，做的漂亮才行。”

谢雍把手轻轻覆盖在她的小腹上，道：“那就日久见人心吧，让咱儿子作证。”

“要是女儿呢？”

“最好是儿子啊，女儿太难养了，以后她长大了，到哪里给她找个像我这么好的夫婿？”

原宜之噗哧一声笑起来，“脸皮真厚！”

“很厚吗？你再亲亲看？”谢雍凑上来亲吻她。

原宜之用手轻轻推开，“不要，今天很累了。”自从原宜之怀孕后，两人虽然一直同床共枕，偶尔也亲亲摸摸，但再也没做过那挡事。

而今天的原宜之，连亲一亲的欲望都没有。

谢雍却抱住她亲个不停，直到她僵硬的身子开始软化，悲伤的神情渐渐消散，眼底的忧愁渐渐退去，谢雍才轻拍着她，陪着她一起入睡。

直到原宜之睡熟了，谢雍悄悄从里衣袖袋里取出小小的泪包，藏到了自己枕头底下，提醒着自己明天一早要取走，免得穿帮。

睡着前，他模糊地想着，小小的泪包妙用无穷，玄昱真是个奇妙的皇帝。

七日后，金陵，谢府。

谢母一身正装地从内廷公公的手里接过圣旨，只觉得天旋地转，眼前发黑。

这道圣旨和当初皇家赐封她为太淑人时截然相反，是撤销她的诰封的。

当年朝廷为了嘉奖谢母抚育儿子有功，谢雍也主动为母亲请封，于是皇帝赐封她为三品太淑人——母亲因儿子获得诰封的，要在品级前面加个‘太’字，以示与妻子的三品淑人相区别。

以后谢雍如果品级再向上升，那么他的母亲和妻子的品级也会随之上升，分别变为‘太夫人’与‘夫人’。

而这次皇帝的圣旨就是收回谢母的诰命，以及与诰命相匹配的服装与配饰，而理由则是她‘不慈，有失妇德、有损官体，不堪为天下妇人之表率’。

谢母傻了许久，才在丁锦芸的帮助下，取出了她一直小心供奉着的诰命，又脱下了身上的诰命服饰，交回已经等得不耐烦的太监手里。

脱下诰命服，她就从官身变回了白丁，和普通百姓没啥两样了，她再也不配被称为‘老夫人’，而是变成了一个普通的‘老太太’。

等太监收好诰命与诰命服饰转身要走时，谢母才发疯一样大喊道：“是原家那个小贱人做的是不是？是她要报复老身是不是？仗势欺人！我就知道，我就知道她是个烂心烂肺的贱货！我要儿子休了她，我要告她忤逆、不孝！”

太监翻了翻白眼，冷声道：“谢老太太，看在你养育了个状元儿子的份上，咱家劝你慎言惜命。还有，这请求撤销诰命的摺子是谢状元亲自上的，可没原小姐什么事儿。谢状元这也是为了你全始全终，能够安稳地活到老才上的摺子，你老惜福吧，别再折腾了，不然哪天皇上一怒，别说你的诰命，就连谢状元的官印都得收回。得了，该说的话咱家也都说完了，告辞！”

太监甩手离去，留下谢母伫立寒风中，久久无法回神。

儿子亲自请求的？

为什么？

为什么？为什么？

站在谢母身后的丁锦芸也傻眼了，她没有想到谢雍会如此决绝。

丁锦芸到达扬州的第二天就又被强行送回了金陵，谢雍不承认这门亲事，可是丁锦芸自认是谢母做主抬进家门的正经媳妇，便厚着脸皮留在了金陵谢府，就这样不明不白地苦熬日子。

丁锦芸想不到的是，当时随同她一起到达金陵的，还有谢雍上给皇帝请求撤销母亲诰命的摺子。

谢雍从来不乱发脾气，他怒极、气极，终于出手之后，就是对谢母的致命打击——谢母最在乎的朝廷赐封。

事情闹到如今的地步，已是新的谢府之耻，这对谢雍未来的升官之路极为不利。

但是谢雍不在乎，他再也无法容忍这样胡闹非为的母亲了，如果再不能让她安分一点，再白白害了一个无辜女子，他会发疯。
content_en:
It was okay not to mention it. Once this topic was brought up, Yuan Yizhi became even more angry.

Mother Xie is just an ignorant old woman, an old bastard!

Calling her old and disrespectful was just to give her face. She was simply seeking death herself and ending her son's career.

Yuan Yizhi has grown up and has seen confused elders, but she has never seen such a stupid one. It is hard to believe that Xie Yong, the number one scholar who won three yuan in a row, was raised by her alone!

I'm afraid Xie Yong is actually very talented, and bad bamboo will produce good bamboo shoots, right?

Such a bastard father and such a stupid mother could actually raise a genius like Xie Yong!

Grandma Sun held down the excited Yuan Yizhi. Thinking about it, what she said made sense, but how could a woman run away from home so easily?Moreover, my young lady had the reputation of being a cheat in the past, so she finally got married. If something goes wrong again, she might not be able to get married in her lifetime.

"Don't be impatient. The old lady has made the decision without authorization, but what you should care about is my uncle's attitude. Let's see how he handles it first." Yuan Yizhi thought for a while, then slowly lay down, and finally said: "Okay, wait for now."

That day, Yuan Yizhi kept looking down at her little face that was sallow due to morning sickness. She felt that it was ridiculous and sad that she had become a "yellow-faced woman" within three months of her marriage.

She ignored Xie Yong until she went to bed at night.

Xie Yong understood her anger, so why didn't he?

At that time, he was holding the letter, and he really used up all the reason in his life to prevent himself from going crazy.

He thought that being away from his mother would make her calmer and rational, but he never expected that she would become even more violent.

Yuan Yizhi faced the back of the bed and fell asleep with his eyes closed.

Xie Yong hugged her gently from behind. She struggled a little, but he hugged her tighter and she stopped moving.

Xie Yong said: "Don't be angry, okay? I have read medical books and it is not good for pregnant women and babies to be angry. It is only a fool to get angry at yourself because of other people's stupidity."

Yuan Yizhi muttered: "I'm just a fool! I always feel that good intentions will be rewarded, but I don't know that there are really heartless people in this world!"

Xie Yong was speechless for a long time.

After all, that was his biological mother, who had suffered a lot for him.

Chapter 10(2)

Yuan Yizhi heard no movement for a long time and turned around suspiciously, but was surprised to find Xie Yongzheng crying silently.

The beautiful phoenix eyes were slightly red, and the rolling tears fell silently, making her panic and distressed.

She pouted, hesitated, then gently stretched out her hand to wipe away his tears, and said: "Why are you crying? I haven't cried yet. Really, how can a grown man cry so much, with so many tears? Are you going to let your son laugh at you for being worthless? Okay, okay, I know it's not your fault, and I know it's hard for you to do it. I'm just angry for a while, and I don't blame you for anything. Don't cry, isn't it embarrassing?"

Xie Yong looked directly at her and said: "Yizhi, I know this incident has hurt your heart, but just like I promised you before, I will handle it well, believe me?"

Yuan Yizhi nodded, "I believe you."

Xie Yong finally showed a smile on his face and said: "Linglong and Qingdai are problems of the past. They are infertile and have become useless. They are pitiful. There is no good way out if they are sent away. Let them serve their mother. The Xie Mansion will provide for them in their old age. As for the future, there will be no others."

Yuan Yizhi pursed his lips, wondering if his father had made such a promise to his aunt at that time. Her biological mother, Aunt Zhou, and another grand aunt were also 'past issues'. They were the eldest maids before Zheng married into the Yuan Mansion. But later, there was little Aunt Zheng, the third brother's biological aunt, and now the younger Aunt Meng?

Seeing the disapproval on her face, Xie Yong had no choice but to hold her tightly in his arms and sighed: "You are a bad-tempered girl. You believe what you say, but you don't agree in your heart, right?"

Yuan Yizhi pouted again and whispered: "It's useless to say it beautifully, it's important to do it beautifully."

Xie Yong gently covered her lower abdomen with his hand and said, "Then let's see people's hearts over time, and let our son bear witness."

"What if it's a daughter?"

"It's better to be a son. A daughter is too difficult to raise. When she grows up, where can she find a husband as good as me?"

Yuan Yizhi burst into laughter and said, "You are so thick-skinned!"

"Is it very thick? Can you kiss her again?" Xie Yong came up and kissed her.

Yuan Yizhi pushed it away gently with his hand, "No, I'm very tired today." Since Yuan Yizhi became pregnant, although the two of them have been sleeping in the same bed and occasionally kissing and touching, they have never done that kind of thing again.

But today, Yuan Yizhi didn't even have the desire to kiss.

However, Xie Yong hugged her and kissed her non-stop until her stiff body began to soften, her sad expression gradually dissipated, and the sadness in her eyes gradually receded. Xie Yong then patted her and fell asleep with her.

Until Yuan Yizhi fell asleep, Xie Yong quietly took out a small tear bag from his inner sleeve pocket and hid it under his pillow, reminding himself to take it away early tomorrow morning to avoid getting in trouble.

Before falling asleep, he thought vaguely that a small tear bag was of infinite use and Xuan Yu was really a wonderful emperor.

Seven days later, Jinling, Xie Mansion.

Xie's mother, dressed in formal attire, took over the imperial edict from the inner court father-in-law. She felt like the world was spinning and her eyes were going dark.

This imperial edict was completely opposite to when the royal family conferred the title of Tai Shu on her. It revoked her title.

In order to commend Xie Yong's mother for her meritorious service in raising her son, Xie Yong also took the initiative to apply for a title for his mother, so the emperor granted her the title of Tai Shuren of the third rank. If the mother received the title of Tai Shu for her son, she would add the word "Tai" in front of the grade to distinguish her from his wife's third rank.

In the future, if Xie Yong's rank rises again, the ranks of his mother and wife will also rise accordingly, becoming "Tai Fu" and "Mrs." respectively.

This time, the emperor's imperial edict was to withdraw Xie's mother's edict, as well as the clothes and accessories that matched the edict, and the reason was that she was 'unkind, unworthy of women's virtues, unworthy of official status, and unworthy of setting an example for women in the world'.

Mother Xie was dumbfounded for a long time, and then with the help of Ding Jinyun, she took out the imperial edict that she had been carefully enshrining, took off her imperial edict clothes, and handed it back to the eunuch who was waiting impatiently.

After taking off her official uniform, she transformed from an official back to a white lady, no different from ordinary people. She no longer deserved to be called an 'old lady', but became an ordinary 'old lady'.

When the eunuch put away his imperial edict and his imperial clothes and turned to leave, Xie's mother shouted like crazy: "Did that little bitch from the Yuan family do this? Did she want to take revenge on me? Using her power to bully others! I knew it, I knew she was a heartless bitch! I want my son to divorce her, and I want to sue her for being disobedient and unfilial!"

The eunuch rolled his eyes and said coldly: "Old Madam Xie, considering that you have raised a son who is a champion, we advise you to be careful and cherish your life. Also, Xie Zhuangyuan personally submitted the request to revoke the imperial edict, but it has nothing to do with Miss Yuan. This is also why Xie Zhuangyuan did this.I hope you will be able to live a stable life till the end of your career. Cherish your blessings and stop fussing. Otherwise, the emperor will be angry one day and even Xie Zhuangyuan's official seal will be withdrawn.Come on, we have finished saying what needs to be said. Leave!"

The eunuch threw away his hands and left, leaving Mother Xie standing in the cold wind, unable to recover for a long time.

Did the son personally request it?

Why?

Why?Why?

Ding Jinyun, who was standing behind Xie's mother, was also dumbfounded. She did not expect that Xie Yong would be so decisive.

The day after Ding Jinyun arrived in Yangzhou, she was forcibly sent back to Jinling. Xie Yong did not acknowledge the marriage, but Ding Jinyun believed that she was the serious daughter-in-law that Xie's mother had brought into the house, so she shamelessly stayed in Xie's Mansion in Jinling, and lived a hard life without knowing why.

What Ding Jinyun didn't expect was that Xie Yongshang's request to the emperor to revoke his mother's imperial edict was accompanied by her when she arrived at Jinling.

Xie Yong never lost his temper. He was extremely angry and angry. When he finally took action, it was a fatal blow to Xie's mother - the imperial title that Xie's mother cared about most.

The fact that the matter has reached this point is a new shame for Xie's family, which is extremely detrimental to Xie Yong's future promotion.

But Xie Yong doesn't care. He can no longer tolerate such a misbehaving mother. If he can't let her calm down anymore and harms an innocent woman in vain, he will go crazy.
